title: How do you use an absorb skill that hurts a group of enemies and then heals the entire party as opposed to just the user?

posts.author: SuperPhillip
posts.body:
Struggling to figure this out in my return to RPG Maker MV, and I imagine it'd be easier if I had the Yanfly Skill Core plugin but unfortunately, I do not possess that one. However, I do have the Battle Core Engine that provides with me the delightful side view, if that assists in helping me.
Regardless, I have a summon that is intended to hurt all enemies, absorb some of their HP, and give it to the user's party. Currently, however, it does hurt all enemies (that much is correct), but for instance, if there are three enemies, it will only heal the user of the skill and it will do so three times (i.e. it will show three healing HP numbers one after the other in succession like a tower of numbers).
How would I go about creating the battle scenario I am wanting? Thanks for reading!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Phil32 said:
I imagine it'd be easier if I had the Yanfly Skill Core plugin but unfortunately, I do not possess that one.
Click to expand...
Why? You just download it.
Change the skill's damage type to HP Damage. Change your damage formula as follows:
Code:
v[42] = your damage formula here; v[42]
where 42 is the ID of an available variable. (It will look best for you to set the damage variance to 0% and put any randomness in your formula if you want it)
Then give it the Skill Core notetag:
Code:
<Post-Damage Eval>
$gameParty.aliveMembers().forEach(actor =>
{
    actor.gainHp(v[42]);
    actor.startDamagePopup();
});
</Post-Damage Eval>
Again, changing the 42 to whatever ID you used above. If you don't want them to heal the amount the enemies were damaged, you can perform whatever math you like inside the parentheses where the variable is.
